title: Godot crashing when trying to open project with RTX 2060 on Arch Linux
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.5.2 and v4.7. Flatpak and website download versions.

### System information

Arch Linux - GNOME 50 - Wayland - Godot v4.7 Stable - Ryzen 5 5500 - GeForce RTX 2060 - Kernel 7.0.14-arch1-1 - Driver nvidia-open 610.43.02-10

### Issue description

My friend has a PC with a Ryzen 5 5500 and a GeForce RTX 2060. We're both running Arch Linux, updated to the latest stable packages. The desktop environment is GNOME 50 and we're using Wayland. Every time he tries to open a project on Godot v4.7 or v4.5.2 (even if it's a new one), the application crashes. When I try to open a project on my computer (with a Radeon RX 7600 XT), Godot works fine. It seems to be a GPU specific issue. Error:
```
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.7.stable.mono.official (5b4e0cb0fd279832bbdd69fed5354d4e5ad26f88)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug on: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues
Load address: 7fd49fa00000

[1] 7fd49fa3e270 (main+3e270) - /usr/lib/libc.so.6(+0x3e270) [0x7fd49fa3e270]
-- END OF C++ BACKTRACE --
```
Trying to use `--rendering-driver opengl3` or `--rendering-method compatibility` as launch options still results in a crash. The computer and other applications are working fine.

Thanks.

### Steps to reproduce

Open a new project using Godot v4.5.2 or v4.7 on a computer with Arch Linux (GNOME 50 + Wayland) having an Nvidia GPU with the latest open drivers.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Happens with new projects.
